prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case. Based on the credentials in the information available, **Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics** is a strong Atlanta option to consider: he is a **board-certified prosthodontist**, a specialist in complex tooth replacement and implant restorations, with a Buckhead office at **3379 Peachtree Rd NE, Suite 830**. [Practice details](https://georgiaprosthodontics.com/) · [Credentials](https://www.castleconnolly.com/top-dentists/carlos-castro-prosthodontics-cc332832)

Other qualified options include **Dr. Evan Grodin**, who is listed as board-certified in both prosthodontics and periodontics, and **Dr. Samira Salari** at ClearChoice Atlanta, a board-certified prosthodontist. [Grodin](https://www.drevangrodin.com/dental-implants/) · [Salari](https://www.clearchoice.com/providers/samira-salari/1720494784/)

Before choosing, ask who will **place** the implant and who will **restore** it, what the full treatment plan and total cost include, and whether bone grafting or other procedures may be needed. Consider getting two consultations, especially for a full-arch or complex case.
